content.page_summary: Reference list (items 18–28) from a clinical guideline focused on heart failure. Topics covered include right heart dysfunction, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, NYHA classification, sacubitril/valsartan (PARADIGM-HF), temporal trends and incidence of heart failure, epidemiology and global burden (including GBD 2017), sex differences in new-onset heart failure, and community-based cohort findings (PREVEND). Each reference includes links labeled Google Scholar, Crossref, Search ADS, and PubMed where present.
